scripts.install:all: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm install); done
scripts.build: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run build); done
scripts.test: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm test); done
scripts.lint: for d in services/*/; do (cd "$d" && npm run lint --if-present); done
